Established in 2004, SMEC Power & Technology has grown to become one of Australia's premium providers of electrical products and services to the mining and industrial markets in Australia and overseas.

We have a number of positions currently available including:
- Underground Mining Shift Electricians: Performing scheduled maintenance, statutory testing, inspections, and installation of underground electrical and communication reticulation systems.
- Projects Team Electricians: Looking after our valued clients' installation needs. Projects are diverse and can include initial power station setups, LV & HV mine setups, HV substation installs, camp & office setups, UG fan upgrades & pump station setups, communications, fibre, Cat6, Co-ax & radio telemetry.
- Switchboard Electricians: Design and construct switchboards. These range from small starter panels, VSDs, control centres to 5000A main switchboards.
- Electrical Engineering Technicians: Responsible for Electrical workshop functions for the installation, testing, repair and maintenance of workshop machines, assemblies and related equipment.
- Electrical Engineering Draftsperson: Responsible for providing electrical engineering drafting for the development of electrical equipment and reviewing of electrical systems, and assisting in estimating costs in support of Electrical Engineers and Engineering Technologists.

Prepare inspection reports and qualify the nature of repairs to be carried out. Testing and winding of electric motors. Ability to use Electrical and Mechanical measuring equipment.
- Mechanical Engineering Technician: Responsible for creating plans of mechanical engineering work.

We have positions available within our workshops operating in locations such as Perth and Kalgoorlie to provide installation and maintenance services for our valued clients.

- Ability to pass a police clearance check and pre-employment medical checks (as well as regular drug and alcohol screening)
- Experience in reading and understanding electrical schematics

- The ability to organise your workload and plan accordingly to complete tasks

Remuneration packages between $78,000 - $90,000 will be offered to the successful candidates.

result.description:
About Us

JBS Australia is the largest and most respected meat and food producer in Australia. We have a strong portfolio of leading and renowned beef, lamb, pork, salmon and value-added branded products, such as AMH, Swift, Primo, Murray Valley and Huon.

JBS Australia’s Northern Division operates five strategically placed processing facilities as well as five feedlots across Queensland and New South Wales, with access to an extensive network of quality cattle. Our network provides the ability to meet the specific demands of various market segments with an extensive range of grain-fed and pasture-fed products. With approximately 15,000 employees spread across our offices, processing plants and feedlots, JBS Australia exports to more than 50 countries around the world.

About the Role

An exciting opportunity is opening for a maintenance planner for our Dinmore Site, it is a full-time role and responsible for our Dinmore site Maintenance related tasks. The annual salary for this role is not less than $79,423.00 plus superannuation.

The maintenance planer is responsible for a wide range of engineering and maintenance activities associated with the operations of multiple cattle feedlots. The maintenance planner develops and implements long-term and short-term maintenance plans for all mechanical and electrical equipment to optimize feedlot safety, quality, equipment availability, and reliability outcomes. The role provides direction and guidance to the feedlot maintenance team members to ensure the safe and efficient maintenance and repair of the electrical and mechanical assets. Additionally, the role identifies and implements continuous improvement opportunities in processes, systems, and equipment, and manages nominated capital projects.

ABOUT THE COMPANY
Mayfly Ventures Pty Ltd is a venture studio founded in 2022 and based in Melbourne, Victoria, specialising in building vertical SaaS and AI ventures. The team comprises engineers, designers, and venture builders who partner with industry experts to design, build, and launch disruptive technology products. Mayfly's core capabilities span venture building, solution design (UX/UI design, UX research, business process mapping, and product strategy), and full product development including MVP delivery, AI agent development, mobile applications, and SaaS platforms.

The studio works with both established businesses and growth-stage startups, specialising in rapidprototyping and iterative product development to help clients achieve product-market fit and reduce the technical barriers between idea and execution.

ABOUT THE ROLE
Mayfly Ventures is seeking an experienced Developer Programmer to join our team on a full-time basis. This is a hands-on, end-to-end product delivery role in which you will architect, design, build, and maintain web and mobile applications across concurrent client and in-house venture projects.
You will work closely with founders, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to translate requirements into high-quality, scalable software solutions, leveraging modern no-code platforms, AI tooling, and best-practice software development methods.

KEY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
• Lead end-to-end design and development of web and mobile applications, managing priorities, timelines, and delivery across multiple concurrent projects
• Analyse user requirements and translate them into software specifications, user flows, information architecture, and technical design decisions
• Architect scalable, performant application structures including database design, backend workflow logic, and API integration strategies
• Design and develop responsive, high-fidelity user interfaces applying UI/UX design principles to maximise usability, engagement, and product quality
• Build and maintain integrations with third-party APIs and external services to extend
application functionality

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS
Candidates must demonstrate the following:
• Bachelor’s degree or higher in a relevant field such as Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent
• Minimum 5 years of proven experience as a Developer Programmer, Software Developer, or equivalent, with a strong portfolio of delivered software projects
• Proficiency in no-code application development, particularly Bubble.io, with demonstrated ability to build complex, production-grade web and mobile applications
• Solid understanding of database design, data modelling, relational structures, and backend workflow logic
• Demonstrated experience integrating REST APIs and third-party services into production application environments
• Strong UI/UX design capability including wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity interface design using tools such as Figma
• Working knowledge of HTML and CSS for front-end customisation and interface optimisation
• Experience applying Agile methodologies and using project management tools such as ClickUp, Jira, Asana, or Trello
• Excellent analytical thinking and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail and system-level thinking
• Effective communication and stakeholder management abilities, with capacity to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced delivery environment

DESIRABLE ATTRIBUTES
• Experience designing and deploying AI-integrated product features and agentic or automated decision workflows
• Familiarity with additional platforms and tools such as Cursor, Bubble, Xano, and AI
• Experience with payment infrastructure integration (e.g. Stripe Connect) and end-to-end monetisation flow design
• Experience leading small development or design teams across concurrent client-facing delivery engagements
• Experience working across multiple industries including fintech, health, education, logistics, or hospitality technology sectors

HOW TO APPLY
Interested candidates should submit a current resume, a cover letter addressing the key
selection criteria, and examples of relevant projects or a portfolio link to careers@mayflyventures.com

Electroplater positions available in all states NSW, Qld, Vic, & WA

At NEPEAN™ we are proud to be Australia’s leading privately owned engineering, mining services and industrial manufacturing organisation. We have unique capabilities to deliver high value, innovative and sustainable solutions for the world’s leading mining, construction, and transport companies. Over the last 40 years, hard work, technical credibility, and a willingness to tackle very difficult projects have earned NEPEAN an enviable reputation. Today our organisation employs over 1400 people across six continents and distributes products to more than 65 countries.

We service our customers through multiple businesses in our portfolio: NEPEAN Building and Infrastructure (Galserv, Galintel, Weldlok), NEPEAN Engineering and Innovation, NEPEAN Power, Mining (NEPEAN Longwall), PROK, NEPEAN Conveyors, NEPEAN Transport, Gurtec, Roxon, and NEPEAN Belting Mackay.

NEPEAN Power specialises in design and manufactures high quality electrical equipment. Our products can be found throughout the Australian and international mining, construction, and industrial sectors. NEPEAN Power is also level 3 Service Providers (ASP3) for designing distribution works in NSW.

We are currently offering a fantastic opportunity for Electroplaters to be based at our NSW Office. We offer full-time permanent employment and short-term 3-6 months' non-ongoing contracts.

Key Responsibilities:
Surface Preparation: Cleaning, degreasing, pickling, and etching metal parts to remove rust, scale, and oil, ensuring proper coating adhesion
Process Control: Setting up and operating plating machinery, including adjusting electrical currents (voltage/amperage), temperature, and immersion times
Chemical Management: Preparing, monitoring, and maintaining electrolytic solutions to the objects to be coated. Test and adjust plating solutions to maintain desired specifications
Quality Inspection: Inspecting finished products for defects (e.g., bubbles, uneven coverage) and measuring coating thickness using tools like micrometers
Equipment Maintenance: Cleaning tanks, maintaining hoists, and repairing machinery, such as replacing anodes or cleaning ventilation systems
Safety Compliance: Adhering strictly to health and safety regulations (PPE, chemical handling) due to exposure to hazardous materials and high temperatures

Required Qualifications, Skills, Knowledge, & Abilities:
Must have at least 3+ years of working experience in metal finishing or manufacturing environments
Relevant trade qualifications
Strong technical knowledge and understanding of metallurgy, chemical reactions, and corrosion protection
Knowledge of electroplating/ galvanising techniques and processes
Ability to read and interpret blueprints and schematics
Physical ability to lift heavy metal products and operate machinery
Attention to Detail: Precision in monitoring, and inspecting to meet strict quality standards
Experience in maintaining electroplating/ galvanising equipment and troubleshooting issues
Strong knowledge of hazardous materials and safety equipment (respirators, protective clothing)
Good communication skills and ability to work in a team environment

If you believe you have the right skills, experience and passion for succeeding in this role, please submit your cover letter and resume for consideration.

NEPEAN believes in diversity and is committed to providing Equal Employment opportunities for all applicants. We welcome applicants from all walks of life which also included various socio-economic, cultural, LGBTIQ, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander backgrounds.

Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super
